It all started with my wife. She absolutely loves creating with Midjourney, making tons of beautiful artworks every day . "Because AI generates a 4-grid image, and if I want to save just one, this is the only way..."

And that’s when I decided—I had to build something to make this easier for her! Without telling her, I stayed up late working on a small tool, constantly tweaking it to make it as convenient as possible. After over 30 iterations, GridSplit was finally born—a little assistant designed to make saving images effortless.

 It’s super easy to use:

Just drag in an image (whether from your computer or browser)
- Choose your preferred splitting method (2×2, 3×3—whatever you need!)
- Click to save the one you love, instantly!

apps.description:
Wasabi 50

A habit-tracking app based on the Project 50 concept, designed to help you record and practice Project 50 more effectively.

Early Rising + Morning Routine + Exercise + Reading & Learning + Healthy Eating + Journaling = Life Transformation Formula

Key Highlights
1. Visual Magic Wall – 50 digital sticky notes automatically spread, and progress interruptions never disappear.
2. Soul-Searching Journaling – Each habit comes with fun prompts like "What did you realize while working out today?"
3. Social Sharing Assistant – After logging your progress, generate stylish growth cards with one tap.
4. Anti-Grind Mode – 15 minutes = 1 hour of workout; Sleeping 8 hours = Waking up early successfully.

Why Choose Wasabi 50?
* A special cure for chronic procrastinators
* A visual progress wall – Start collecting your gold stars on the board.
* 7 habit-specific “cheat codes” – You define the rules:
    * "Failed to wake up early? Sleeping well counts too."
    * "No time to read? Audiobooks count."
* No social ranking | No spammy reminders | No perfectionism pressure

Wasabi 50 Might Not Be for You If:
* You want to freely add/remove habits (We focus on 7 core habits).
* You need others to supervise your progress (Here, you have only a warm progress wall).
* You expect a flawless streak record (Missed 3 days? Just tap to restore progress).

# Wasabi Philosophy
True discipline is not about extreme self-restraint. It’s about reading one more page each day. It’s about having the courage to start again after a break. It’s about looking at your magic wall and thinking, "Wow, I’ve come this far."

Habit Building | Self-Discipline Tool | Growth Journal | Anxiety-Free Design | Life Tracking

• Struggling to wake up early? | Always breaking your reading streak? | An on-and-off fitness enthusiast?
